n: <int> Number of points to be clustered.
d: <int> Number of coordinate dimensions for each point.
epsilon: <float> Maximum allowed Euclidean distance from any point to its assigned hyperplane.
big_M: <float> Largest pairwise Euclidean distance among all points, used to deactivate distance constraints for unassigned point-hyperplane pairs.
upper_bound_K: <int> Maximum number of candidate hyperplanes available for covering the points.
points: <list[list[float]], shape [n][d]> Coordinates of each point in d-dimensional space.
